scripts.firebase:rules:preview: node scripts/guard-firebase-deploy.mjs --environment=preview --project=coderecall-preview && node scripts/verify-release-safety.mjs && set XDG_CONFIG_HOME=.firebase-cli-config&& set NO_UPDATE_NOTIFIER=1&& firebase deploy --only firestore:rules --project preview
scripts.firebase:rules:production: node scripts/guard-firebase-deploy.mjs --environment=production --project=gamifiedlearningsystem && node scripts/verify-release-safety.mjs && set XDG_CONFIG_HOME=.firebase-cli-config&& set NO_UPDATE_NOTIFIER=1&& firebase deploy --only firestore:rules --project production
scripts.firebase:deploy:hosting: echo Firebase Hosting deployment is disabled; CodeRecall hosting is deployed through Vercel && exit /b 1
scripts.firebase:deploy:functions: echo Firebase Functions are disabled for Spark mode
scripts.firebase:deploy:app: echo Generic Firebase app deployment is disabled; use the explicit Firebase Rules command for the intended environment && exit /b 1
scripts.rules:dry-run-claims-only:preview: node scripts/guard-firebase-deploy.mjs --environment=preview --project=coderecall-preview && npm run rules:build-claims-only && set XDG_CONFIG_HOME=.firebase-cli-config&& set NO_UPDATE_NOTIFIER=1&& firebase deploy --config firebase.claims-only.json --only firestore:rules --project preview --dry-run --non-interactive
scripts.rules:dry-run-claims-only:production: node scripts/guard-firebase-deploy.mjs --environment=production --project=gamifiedlearningsystem && npm run rules:build-claims-only && set XDG_CONFIG_HOME=.firebase-cli-config&& set NO_UPDATE_NOTIFIER=1&& firebase deploy --config firebase.claims-only.json --only firestore:rules --project production --dry-run --non-interactive
scripts.test:rules:claims-only: npm run rules:build-claims-only && powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts/run-firestore-rules-tests.ps1 firestore.claims-only.rules firebase.claims-only.json
